scope.mvpBoundarySummary: The initial release delivers customer request management, ticket workflow management, role-based access control, ticket communication, email and/or in-app notifications, searchable knowledge resources, and operational reporting/dashboards. CRM, monitoring-system, survey, SLA-automation, and additional-channel integrations remain out of MVP unless separately approved through change control.

inScope.notes: Request creation, attachment upload, request history, status tracking, and reopening where permitted
Categorization, prioritization, assignment, status transitions, escalation handling, resolution, closure, and audit history
Access for customers, support agents, team leads, and administrators
Customer-agent comments/updates with an auditable conversation record
Email and/or in-app notifications for material ticket lifecycle events
Searchable help articles, FAQs, and guidance for customer self-service
Ticket volume, backlog, workload, priorities, resolution performance, and service-level trends
